subject: Coupa: SAML assertion entropy mismatch — vendor login blocked
messages:
From: Sam Reynolds <sam@stellarnorth.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@stellarnorth.com
Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Coupa invite failing — 'assertion entropy mismatch'

Hi Ben / Marissa,

We tried to accept the Coupa supplier invite this morning (link received at 08:55), but when the user hits the link they immediately see an error page: 'SAML assertion entropy mismatch - relayState signature invalid'. The browser redirects back to our IdP and the session drops.

What we tried:
- Different browsers (Chrome / Safari)
- Clearing cookies / incognito
- Resending invite from the Coupa UI (no luck)

Attached is a quick screenshot of the error message and the network timing. We need this resolved so we can accept POs for the May shipments.

Can you advise next steps and whether a manual onboarding CSV would be acceptable as a temporary workaround?

Thanks,
Sam Reynolds
Vendor Operations
Stellar North Logistics

Thanks Sam — sorry you're blocked.

Quick notes / next steps from our side:
- Can you send the exact vendor email address that hit the error and the approximate timestamp (to the minute) when they clicked the invite? That lets us correlate with our gateway logs.
- I'm looping in Priyom and Marissa to coordinate an expedited fix and a temporary CSV onboarding if needed.
- Workaround idea: we can generate a one-off manual activation (CSV import) for up to 10 vendor users while we investigate SAML/relayState.

I'll check gateway logs for the timestamps you send and open an internal support ticket HS-5678.

Looping in some engineering context and a temporary plan: 

Summary of likely root cause (quick):
- RelayState or assertion signing included an entropy token that our proxy normalizes for caching; in some edge cases (long URLs or appended tracking params) the signing value doesn't match and IdP rejects the assertion.

Immediate actions we can take:
- Ben / Marissa: we can issue a sanitized invite link (no query-string trackers) which has worked in similar cases. Please confirm and we'll resend.
- If vendor needs immediate PO visibility: accept CSV onboarding. Ben — can you confirm the list of fields Stellar needs to appear on the PO (company name, remit address, tax id, payment terms)?
- I'll open an internal ticket to disable relayState normalization for this Coupa tenant for a short window while we debug — won't affect other tenants. Ticket: https://support.redwood.com/tickets/458271

Priyom Das
Account Manager, Redwood Inference

Hi Sam — thanks for the screenshot, that helped. Two options to unblock you today: 

1) We resend a sanitized invite (no tracking params). Please confirm the primary vendor contact email you want on the account and whether you need the following fields populated on import: legal name, remit address, tax ID, payment terms, preferred PO email.

2) We can do a manual CSV import. If you choose this path, please send the CSV with the column headers in the sample we attached below (I included the sample as inline guidance). We'll target to complete imports within 24 hours of receiving the file.

If you want us to proceed with (1) we will:
- Resend sanitized invite within 30 minutes of your confirmation.
- Keep HS-5678 open until we verify a successful login.

If you prefer (2) please send the CSV to onboarding@redwood.com and cc me; I'll triage priority.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Manager, Supplier Success
